gen.title: Quick check on DNA sequencing and base pairing

cards.quote: DNA sequencing determines the order of the four chemical building blocks - called "bases" - that make up the DNA molecule.
cards.hint: Recall the definition given in the opening sentence.

cards.stem: Which base pairing always occurs in the double helix?
cards.quote: Adenine (A) always pairs with thymine (T); cytosine (C) always pairs with guanine (G).
cards.hint: Think about the fixed partners for A and C.

cards.stem: How is nanopore-based sequencing described as working?
options: threading single DNA strands through extremely tiny pores in a membrane
copying DNA with colored dyes and a fast camera
comparing 1 million bases from different people
cards.quote: Nanopore-based DNA sequencing involves threading single DNA strands through extremely tiny pores in a membrane.
cards.hint: Focus on the method that threads single strands.
